pages.text: PROBLEM 18-3 How would you prepare the following ethers using a Williamson synthesis? (a) Methyl propyl ether (b) Anisole (methyl phenyl ether) (c) Benzyl isopropyl ether (d) Ethyl 2,2-dimethylpropyl ether
